name: @rpgm-tools/neo-angband-desktop
description: Electron front end: the same web app, handed a real filesystem and argv
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)

scripts.dist: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @rpgm-tools/neo-angband-web bundle && pnpm build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:ci: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @rpgm-tools/neo-angband-web bundle && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @rpgm-tools/neo-angband-web bundle && pnpm build && electron-builder --win portable

_buildNote: linux.executableName is REQUIRED and is not cosmetic. Left unset,
electron-builder derives it from `name` - which is scoped - and produces
characters that cannot be safely used in file paths'. Both the AppImage and
the tar.gz fail. Windows and macOS are unaffected because they name their
output from productName, which is why the first release built two platforms
out of three and the Linux job was the only one red.
And the whole `build` block is VALIDATED ON EVERY PLATFORM, so a bad key
under `linux` kills the Windows and macOS jobs too. The second attempt did
the option is `linux.syncDesktopName`. packaging.test.ts validates this
object against electron-builder's own scheme.json now, because a test that
asserts the keys I believe in agrees with me rather than with the builder.
